dimensions.assessment: Affects individuals with diabetes using group or individual health insurance, uninsured insulin users, and manufacturers of insulin products.
dimensions.evidence: a group health plan or health insurance issuer offering group or individual health insurance coverage shall provide coverage of selected insulin products

dimensions.assessment: Caps patient cost-sharing at $35 or 25 percent of the net price per 30-day supply and eliminates deductibles for selected insulin products.
dimensions.evidence: shall not-- (1) apply any deductible; or (2) impose any cost-sharing requirements in excess of, per 30-day supply... $35

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $2,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2032 for a resource center and hotline.
dimensions.evidence: there are authorized to be appropriated $2,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2032.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Public Health Service Act, Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, and Internal Revenue Code of 1986, and adds a new FDA biosimilar competition designation process.
dimensions.evidence: Subpart II of part A of title XXVII of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 300gg-11 et seq.) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory changes take effect for plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2028, with grant funding authorized through fiscal year 2032.
dimensions.evidence: For plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2028, a group health plan or health insurance issuer offering group or individual health insurance coverage shall provide coverage

importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires group health plans and issuers to cap cost-sharing for selected insulin products, establishes a resource center and hotline for uninsured individuals with $2,000,000 authorized to be appropriated annually, and expedites biosimilar competition.
